overzichtModel.query: FROM (SELECT f.*, (SELECT sum(b.bedrag) FROM betalingen AS b INNER JOIN salon_afspraak_betalingen AS sab ON b.betaling_id = sab.betaling_id WHERE sab.salon_afspraak_id = f.salon_afspraak_id) AS totaal_betalingen FROM salon_afspraken AS f :f.where) AS f LEFT JOIN klanten AS k ON f.klant_id = k.klant_id LEFT JOIN salon_afspraak_regels AS r ON f.salon_afspraak_id = r.salon_afspraak_id LEFT JOIN salon_afspraak_regel_producten AS p ON r.salon_afspraak_regel_id = p.salon_afspraak_regel_id

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(d.naam ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM salon_afspraak_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.salon_afspraak_id = f.salon_afspraak_id))
veld.label: Dier(en)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(soort.naam ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM salon_afspraak_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id LEFT JOIN rassen AS ras ON d.ras_id = ras.ras_id LEFT JOIN diersoort AS soort ON ras.diersoort_id = soort.diersoort_id WHERE (r.salon_afspraak_id = f.salon_afspraak_id))
veld.label: Diersoort(en)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(concat(ras.naam,IF(d.kruising,' (kr.)','')) ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM salon_afspraak_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id LEFT JOIN rassen AS ras ON d.ras_id = ras.ras_id WHERE (r.salon_afspraak_id = f.salon_afspraak_id))
veld.label: Ras(sen)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(IF(d.geslacht = 'Mannelijk','M',IF(d.geslacht = 'Vrouwelijk','V','?')) ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM salon_afspraak_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.salon_afspraak_id = f.salon_afspraak_id))
veld.label: Geslacht

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(concat(k.naam) ORDER BY k.naam ASC separator '; ') AS werkplekken FROM werkplekken AS k JOIN salon_afspraak_regels AS r ON k.werkplek_id = r.werkplek_id WHERE (r.salon_afspraak_id = f.salon_afspraak_id))
veld.label: Werkplek(ken)
